2608.13277.title: Mixture of Training: Recombining Small-Scale Scaffolded Pretraining Runs into a Larger Language Model
2608.13277.paper_summary: We ask whether language-model pre-training can be decomposed into smaller, independently trainable jobs that can later be recomposed into a coherent larger model. We introduce Mixture of Training (MoT), a scaffolded modular pre-training procedure that partitions a target Transformer into contiguous layer blocks, trains each block inside a frozen pretrained aligner scaffold, and then recomposes the trained blocks with an optional short end-to-end adaptation pass. On a 1.3B-parameter Gemma-style model trained on C4, MoT provides a small-scale proof of mechanism: independently trained depth slices can be recomposed into a usable language model, and a quality-parity schedule reaches the same reported perplexity as the monolithic baseline. This parity setting processes more aggregate tokens and has a shorter idealized layer-equivalent critical path after aligner preparation; its effective compute advantage depends on reusing the aligner across runs. We therefore present MoT not as a general replacement for monolithic pre-training, but as a small-scale framework for studying whether scaffolded sub-runs can act as reusable training units.
2608.13277.paper_summary_zh: 我們詢問語言模型的預訓練是否可以分解為更小的、獨立可訓練的任務，這些任務可以在後來重新組合成一個連貫的更大模型。<lb/>我們介紹了訓練混合（Mixture of Training, MoT），這是一種支架模組化預訓練程序，將目標Transformer劃分為連續的層塊，在一個冷凍的預訓練對齊支架內訓練每個塊，然後將訓練好的塊與可選的短期端到端適應過程重新組合。<lb/>在一個基於C4訓練的1.3B參數Gemma風格模型上，MoT提供了一個小規模的機制證明：獨立訓練的深度切片可以重新組合成可用的語言模型，並且質量平衡計劃達到了與單體基線相同的困惑度。<lb/>這種平衡設置處理了更多的聚合標記，並且在對齊器準備後具有更短的理想化層等效關鍵路徑；其有效計算優勢取決於在多次運行中重用對齊器。<lb/>因此，我們將MoT呈現為一種小規模框架，而不是單體預訓練的一般替代品，用於研究支架子運行是否可以作為可重用的訓練單元。
